29:2: Did people think that they would be left alone by saying 'We have believed' and that they would not be tested?
29:3: And by oath, We certainly tested those before them. Allah surely knows those who speak the truth, and He surely knows the liars.
29:4: Or did those who do evil deeds think that they would escape Us? How badly they judge!
29:5: Whoever hopes to meet Allah, surely Allah's appointed time is certainly coming, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
29:6: And whoever strives, he only strives for his own self. Surely Allah is free of need of the worlds.
29:7: And those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will surely cover their evil deeds and We will surely reward them with the best of what they used to do.
29:8: And We enjoined upon man to do good to his parents. If they exert pressure on you to associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, then do not obey them.
29:9: And those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will surely admit them among the righteous.
29:10: And of people is he who says: 'We have believed in Allah.' Then when he suffers harm in the cause of Allah, he treats the persecution of people like the punishment of Allah. And by oath, if help comes from your Rabb, they will surely say: 'Indeed, we were with you.' Is not Allah the Best Knower of what is in the breasts of the worlds?
29:11: And Allah surely knows those who believe, and He surely knows the hypocrites.
29:12: And those who disbelieved said to those who believed: "Follow our way, and let us bear your sins." Yet they are not about to bear anything of their sins. Surely they are liars.
29:13: They will surely bear their own burdens and other burdens along with their own burdens, and they will surely be questioned about what they used to invent.
29:14: And by oath, We sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years less fifty years. Then the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
29:15: We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.
29:16: And We sent Abraham. At that time he said to his people: "Worship Allah and fear Him. This is better for you, if you know."
29:17: You only worship idols besides Allah and invent falsehood. Surely those you worship besides Allah have no power to provide provision for you. So seek provision with Allah and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned.
29:18: And if you deny, nations before you have also denied. And there is nothing upon the messenger except clear notification.
29:19: Have they not seen how Allah originates creation, then repeats it? Surely this is easy for Allah.
29:20: Say: "Travel in the earth and see how Allah originated creation. Then Allah will bring forth the final creation." Surely Allah is capable of all things.
29:21: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy on whom He wills, and to Him you are returned.
29:22: You cannot escape Him neither on earth nor in the heaven, and for you besides Allah there is neither a protector nor a helper.
29:23: As for those who deny the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him, it is they who have despaired of My mercy, and for them there is a painful punishment.
29:24: The answer of his people was only that they said: "Kill him or burn him!" But Allah saved him from the fire. Surely in that are signs for a people who believe.
29:25: He said: "You have only taken idols besides Allah for the sake of affection among you in the life of this world. Then on the Day of Resurrection some of you will disown others and some of you will curse others. Your abode is the Fire, and there are no helpers for you."
29:26: Thereupon Lot believed in him. And he said: "Surely I am emigrating to my Rabb. Surely He is al-Aziz, al-Hakim."
29:27: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and We placed prophethood and the Book in his offspring, and We gave him his reward in the world, and surely in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.
29:28: And Lot, when he said to his people: 'Surely you commit an indecency that no one among the worlds has committed before you.'
29:29: Do you really approach men, and cut off the highway, and commit evil in your assemblies? The answer of his people was only that they said: "Bring upon us the punishment of Allah, if you are of the truthful."
29:30: He said: "My Rabb, help me against the corrupting people."
29:31: When Our messengers came to Abraham with glad tidings, they said: "Surely we are going to destroy the people of this city. Because its people are wrongdoers."
29:32: He said: "Surely Lot is there." They said: "We know better who is there. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife; she will be of those who remain behind."
29:33: When Our messengers came to Lot, he felt troubled on their account and was distressed on their account. They said: "Do not fear and do not grieve. Surely we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is of those who remain behind."
29:34: Surely we will bring down upon the people of this city a punishment from heaven because they acted defiantly disobedient.
29:35: And by oath, We left of it a clear sign for a people who use reason.
29:36: And to Midian We sent their brother Shuaib. He said: "O my people! Worship Allah, hope for the Last Day, and do not commit corruption on earth as corrupters."
29:37: But they denied him; thereupon an earthquake seized them, and they morning-dawned fallen prone in their dwellings.
29:38: And We destroyed Aad and Thamud. Surely it has become clear to you from their dwellings. Satan made their deeds appear pleasing to them and turned them away from the path.
29:39: And We destroyed Korah, Pharaoh, and Haman. And by oath, Moses had come to them with clear proofs, yet they acted arrogantly on earth, but they could not escape.
29:40: Each one We seized for his sin. Upon some of them We sent a storm of stones, some were seized by the awful cry, some We caused the earth to swallow, and some We drowned in water. Allah was not to wrong them, but they were wronging their own selves.
29:41: The example of those who take protectors besides Allah is like the example of the spider that takes a house. Surely the frailest of houses is indeed the house of the spider, if they only knew.
29:42: Surely Allah knows whatever thing they call upon besides Him. And He is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
29:43: And these examples We present for mankind, and none understand them except those who know.
29:44: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Surely in that is a sign for the believers.
29:45: Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish salah. Surely salah restrains from indecency and evil. And the remembrance of Allah is surely the greatest.
29:46: Dispute with the People of the Scripture only with that which is best, except those among them who do wrong, and say: "We have believed in that which was sent down to us and sent down to you. Our God and your God is One, and we are ones who submit to Him."
29:47: And thus We have sent down the Book to you. Those to whom We gave the Book believe in it. And among these are those who believe in it. And only the disbelievers deny Our verses.
29:48: You did not read any book before it, nor did you write it with your right hand. In that case, the followers of falsehood would have doubted.
29:49: Rather, it is clear verses in the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And only the wrongdoers deny Our verses.
29:50: And they said: If only signs were sent down to him from his Rabb. Say: Signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner.
29:51: Did it not suffice them that We sent down to you the Book which is being recited to them? Surely in that is indeed a mercy and a reminder for a people who believe.
29:52: Say: Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens and on the earth. And He also knows those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in Allah.
29:53: They ask you to hasten the punishment. If there were not a specified term, the punishment would have come to them, and by oath it will come to them suddenly while they are not aware.
29:54: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Surely Hell is encompassing the disbelievers.
29:55: On that day, the punishment will cover them from above them and from beneath their feet, and will say: "Taste what you used to do!"
29:56: O My servants who believe! Surely My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
29:57: Every soul will taste death, then to Us you will be returned.
29:58: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will surely settle them in chambers in Paradise beneath which rivers flow; they are abiding therein eternally. How excellent is the reward of the workers!
29:59: Those who were patient and put their trust in their Rabb.
29:60: And how many a living creature does not carry its provision; Allah provides for it and for you, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
29:61: And by oath, if you were to ask them who created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon, they would surely say Allah. How then are they turned away?
29:62: Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts it for him. Surely Allah is Knower of all things.
29:63: And by oath, if you were to ask them, 'Who sent down water from the sky and revived the earth with it after its death?' they would surely say, 'Allah.' Say: Praise is to Allah. But most of them do not reason.
29:64: This worldly life is only an amusement and a play. And the home of the Hereafter is indeed the real life. If only they knew.
29:65: When they board the ship, they pray to Allah making religion pure for Him, but when We deliver them to land, they immediately associate partners.
29:66: So that they may be ungrateful for what We gave them and that they may enjoy; soon they will know.
29:67: Did they not see that We have made a secure sanctuary while people around them are being snatched away? Do they believe in falsehood and deny the blessing of Allah?
29:68: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not an abode in Hell for the disbelievers?
29:69: And those who strived within Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways, and surely Allah is with those who do good.
